title: Different needs make room for farewell

captions.energy: Seeking a combination of different needs

meaning: Open shared action to combine needs is emotionally accompanied by farewell to an earlier phase without cancelling possible further involvement.
text: The Star in the physical position of this Energy Field appears through open shared actions: you may share attention, show something important without demanding return and leave room for possibility. Temperance in energy motivates combining different needs and recognising their influence on a common decision. Death in emotions adds the experience of a familiar phase ending. Another measure of participation can be open and attentive to differences while the earlier form still brings emotional farewell. This predicts no relationship ending and proves no requirement that a suitable decision immediately feel only pleasant to both people.

For example, you freely share the final selection from a journal you made together. One person needs less regular work, while the other values retaining occasional publications. Combining requests supports another format, but the familiar monthly pages bring sadness. **We retain open involvement and say goodbye to a familiar rhythm.** The emotional ending concerns a particular phase; it cancels neither the value of completed work nor a possibility of continuing differently if each person genuinely wants that later.

Farewell becomes harder if combining needs prohibits regret: because everyone has a place, sadness supposedly should not exist. A pleasant scheme closes a living response. Death requires no identical timetable of feeling, and Temperance guarantees no finished harmony. The Star in action permits possibility without promised return, leaving different time for both people to make the transition and no obligation to fill every ending with another shared commitment. Practical suitability and emotional timing can remain distinct.
